thread:
tanya: Quick triage: nova-mini q5 bring-up failing multilang smoke. Mixed Japanese (vertical layout) with small Arabic inline has parentheses detaching and Hebrew/Arabic digits mirrored in output. Repro below.
hiro: paste the command + input?
tanya: ran local quick-eval on cpu fallback:
```
./ci/run_smoke --model=models/nova-mini:q5-dyn --suite=multiorient_quick --input=tests/vert_jp_ar.json
```
Input snippet:
```


```
(kept control chars out of this JSON; real input: fullwidth paren enclosing Arabic phrase and digits: 『歌詞（مرحبا ١٢٣）』)
Observed output:
```
(مرحبا ٣٢١）歌詞)
```
Digits reversed and closing bracket moved after the Arabic span.
qa: metrics: fp16 baseline BLEU 26.8 -> q5 19.2 on this suite. Token mismatch +52/220, concentrated on CJK+RTL interleaves.
hiro: is this q4/q6 too?
tanya: quick checks: q8 fine, q4 slight glitches, q5 worst. Only reproducible on cpu_fallback_v1; GPU path OK.
eval-bot: Auto-failure: id=ml-quick-3162801234-a; model_sha=9b8e1d; repo=infra/models/nova-mini; kernel=cpu_fallback_v1
tanya: run config excerpt: quant: {scheme: q5_dynamic, per_channel: true} runtime: {fallback: cpu_fallback_v1} tokenizer: {detok: detok-legacy}
hiro: legacy detok doesn't preserve bidi joiners in some short spans. Hypothesis: token packer or detok path stripping ZWJ/ZWSP on q5 artifacts. I'll try swapping detok to detok-bidi-v2 on the q5 artifact and re-run.
qa: please add unit tests: bracket-attachment + numeric-orientation to multiorient_quick. CI gate for quant builds.
tanya: logs uploaded s3://redwood-triage/3162801234/nova-q5-logs.tgz. Created ticket RI-1523 and added sample id vjmix-3162801234 to tests/seed_mixed.json.
infra-bot: Canary hold: nova-mini q5 auto-promote paused in ap-northeast-1 until triage complete (reason: locale regression).
hiro: plan: (1) swap detok to bidi-v2 on q5 and re-run; (2) if repro persists, bisect cpu_fallback_v1 detok branches; (3) add small unit test and a synthetic short-span fuzz set.
tanya: mitigation: route CJK-multiorient traffic to nova-mini-fp16 for now. Will monitor canary BLEU.
qa: I'll prepare the test PR and add the failing sample. Thanks team.
infra-bot: Rollback policy: auto-route to fp16 on BLEU delta >4 or error-rate spike >2/min.
hiro: ping me if you want help on the bisect, I can instrument token-unpack traces.
